agentUnavailable: Trying to connect. If this continues, restart FutureOS.
description: Let a phone, tablet, or another computer use this machine's conversations remotely (tools still run here). Once enabled, local conversations are mirrored to the connected devices, and they can drive the same session.
hostToggleDescription: Let other devices connect to and use this computer remotely. Off means this computer accepts no remote connections.
preparingPairingHint: Establishing a secure connection. The QR code will appear when it is ready.
pairingCodeExpired: That pairing code expired. Add the device again.
unpairConfirmDesc: This device will no longer control this computer. Pair it again if you want it back.
pairingCodeHint: Scan the QR code with the mobile app (it can only be used once). On another computer, copy the pairing code above and paste it into Remote → Connect to another computer.
copyFailed: Copy failed — copy the code manually.
note: Remote connections need this computer to stay on and online.
